jobs.title: Head of Supply Chain
jobs.notes: Target company, bumped C to B. Regional leadership role that builds Hypersonica's German supply-chain capability from first principles: supplier network for aerospace and defence hardware from prototype to production, sourcing and contracting, close work with Engineering. Verified live 2026-11-24 on the company's Lever page. Gaps: sourcing and supplier development is the core, hands-on build-the-function role, travel to suppliers and sites, early-stage start-up so pay is unconfirmed (inferred risk). Same company also has the Director of Industrialisation role on the board.
